item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera walks in a straight line along the school corridor. Her friend notes the distance she covers every 5 seconds: 6 m in the first 5 seconds, 6 m in the next 5 seconds, and 6 m in the last 5 seconds.
What kind of motion does Meera have?

options.A: Non-uniform linear motion, because she is walking along a corridor
options.B: Uniform linear motion, because she covers equal distances in equal time intervals along a straight line
options.C: Non-uniform linear motion, because she covers only 6 m each time
options.D: Uniform linear motion, because any motion along a straight line is always uniform
